title: betula platyphylla f. laciniata
intro: Betula platyphylla f. laciniata, commonly known as the Japanese paperbark birch or laciniated paperbark birch, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Betulaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in Eastern medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Betula platyphylla f. laciniata include reducing fever, relieving cough and sore throat, and acting as an antimicrobial agent, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
